name: Field
description:
Wires a label, description and error message to one control - Input, Textarea, Select… - and validates it.

  Field(name: "email", validation_mode: :blur, messages: { value_missing: "Email is required" }) do
    FieldLabel { "Email" }
    Input(type: "email", required: true)
    FieldDescription { "We'll send your receipt here." }
    FieldError()
  end

`control_id:` sets the control's id (a form builder passes Rails' `user_name`). The control gets the field's id, `name:`, `aria-describedby`, and its disabled / invalid state. Server-side errors: `error: "Email is taken"` renders invalid with that message. In the browser, the native constraints (required, type, pattern, minlength…) are checked on :submit (default), :blur or :change; `messages:` overrides the browser's text per failure (value_missing, type_mismatch, pattern_mismatch, too_short…).
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Field(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

FieldDescription.description: Supporting text, announced as the control's description.

FieldLabel.description: The field's label, bound to its control (clicking it focuses the control).

FieldsetLegend.description: The fieldset's heading, naming the group.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: A label above the control, a description below - all associated automatically.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Field(disabled:, validation_mode:, control_id:, **given(name:), class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    FieldLabel { "Email" }
    Input(type: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com")
    FieldDescription { "We'll send your receipt here." }
  end
end

examples.name: Validation
examples.notes:
`validation_mode: :blur` checks the native constraints when the field loses focus; the
message comes from `messages:` or the browser, and FieldError slides it in.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Field(class: "w-full max-w-70", validation_mode: :blur,
    messages: { value_missing: "Email is required", type_mismatch: "Enter a valid email address" }) do
    FieldLabel { "Email" }
    Input(type: "email", required: true, placeholder: "you@example.com")
    FieldDescription { "Validates when the field loses focus." }
    FieldError()
  end
end

examples.name: Server errors
examples.notes:
`error:` renders the field invalid with the server's message (e.g. from model errors); it
clears as soon as the value becomes valid.
examples.code:
phlex do
  form(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    Field(name: "user[email]", error: "has already been taken") do
      FieldLabel { "Email" }
      Input(type: "email", value: "sarah@appica.dev", required: true)
      FieldError()
    end
    Field(name: "user[bio]", validation_mode: :change) do
      FieldLabel { "Bio" }
      Textarea(minlength: 20, value: "Too short", rows: 2)
      FieldError(match: :too_short) { "Tell us a little more - at least 20 characters." }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Disabled & read-only
examples.notes: `disabled:` on the Field disables its control; read-only is set on the control itself.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-5") do
    Field(disabled: true) do
      FieldLabel { "Email" }
      Input(type: "email", value: "you@example.com")
      FieldDescription { "The whole field is disabled." }
    end
    Field do
      FieldLabel { "API key" }
      Input(value: "sk_live_8f2c91a4", readonly: true)
      FieldDescription { "Focusable and selectable, but not editable." }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Fieldset
examples.notes: Fieldset groups related fields under a legend; `disabled: true` disables them all.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Fieldset(class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    FieldsetLegend { "Shipping address" }
    { "Street" => "123 Main St", "City" => "Springfield", "Postal code" => "12345" }.each do |label, placeholder|
      Field do
        FieldLabel { label }
        Input(placeholder:)
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    Field do
      FieldLabel { "البريد الإلكتروني" }
      Input(type: "email", placeholder: "you@example.com")
      FieldDescription { "سنرسل الإيصال إلى هنا." }
    end
  end
end
